change_families.description: Portable language that adds no case-specific information.
Unsupported claims that something is important, pivotal, transformative, or emblematic.
Grandiose wording that exceeds the evidence or practical stakes.
A claim is assigned to unnamed experts, critics, observers, or research.
A number, date, actor, quotation, or detail is asserted without source support.
The wording is stronger, broader, or different from the cited evidence.
A comparative claim lacks the baseline, population, or time window.
A changing fact is presented without an as-of date or time scope.
Association, sequence, or contribution is upgraded to causation.
Modality is stronger than the evidence permits.
Certainty and uncertainty markers conflict in the same claim.
Negation scope makes the proposition materially unclear.
The actor responsible for a decision or action is obscured where it matters.
A pronoun or referring phrase lacks a clear antecedent.
An inanimate document, section, chart, or concept is assigned implausible agency.
A qualified group or tendency is turned into an absolute claim.
Needless term variation obscures identity or continuity.
The same technical entity is named inconsistently without reason.
A conclusion repeats prior content without adding judgment or action.
A local recap duplicates immediately available information.
A contrast template substitutes drama for a real distinction.
Stacked fragments impede comprehension or create mechanical emphasis.
Repeated sentence shapes produce monotonous, mechanical rhythm.
An opening delays the substantive claim with generic setup.
Abstract nouns unnecessarily hide the responsible actor and action.
A dense sequence of modifiers makes relationships hard to parse.
Clause structure or attachment creates avoidable ambiguity.
A modifier appears to describe the wrong word or action.
An introductory modifier lacks a logical subject.
A passive construction hides responsibility that the reader needs.
Tone conflicts with the declared audience, genre, or stakes.
A response-only phrase, offer, disclaimer, or conversational residue appears in the artifact.
Formatting is inconsistent, broken, or copied from an interface rather than serving the document.
Narrative, table, link, quotation, frontmatter, or code disagrees with another surface.
Identity-bearing, confidential, or real product data appears where sanitized or placeholder data is required.
A specific construction materially obscures meaning, independent of accent or non-native style.

keep_families.description: The actor is unknown, irrelevant, already given, or properly backgrounded.
The punctuation marks a meaningful interruption, apposition, or emphasis in the author's voice.
A three-part list is natural, complete, and not padded.
Domain terminology is precise and should not be simplified away.
Repeated wording maintains cohesion, emphasis, or identity.
A fragment is appropriate for a heading, interface label, note, or deliberate voice.
An unusual but clear construction is part of the declared voice.
A hedge or modal accurately represents uncertainty, permission, or obligation.
Attribution is precise and necessary to preserve evidentiary boundaries.
Code, frontmatter, table syntax, link target, quotation, path, or other exact content must remain unchanged.
Non-native phrasing is comprehensible and does not warrant normalization.
